__doc__: Curated overlay for the Changelog tab. Keyed by short commit hash. Each entry supplies the human-judged fields git cannot infer, and may override the git-derived title/description. Run `node scripts/changelog/build-changelog.mjs` to merge this with `git log` into data/changelog.json (the file the app reads). intensity: low | moderate | high. area: free text. audited: whether Trinity has manually reviewed the change. Only commits listed here appear in the changelog.

PENDING-relative-log-paths.title: Run records now log repository-relative paths only
PENDING-relative-log-paths.description: Added relativize_path() to run_records.py and applied it to the error file, every frame of the error traceback, and all summary values, so a failure record no longer publishes the machine path it was written on. Paths outside the repository fall back to the repo-relative fragment or the bare filename, and the 58 records already in pipeline-runs.jsonl and sample-runs.jsonl were rewritten through the same rule.

75fb3c2.title: Module workbench overhaul: single-screen module editor
75fb3c2.description: Split the chart editor into two surfaces. /[module] is now a single-screen workbench: a persistent control sidebar beside a chart container with View Chart / View Data and Export Chart / Export Data. /visualization-tool keeps the step wizard for bring-your-own-data, along with presets, saved views, the multi-chart workspace, trace layers, and the activity log. Both compose from one shared section registry. Added a view=locations API view and a geographic multi-select; withdrew the settings tiers, the code editor, and the Slopegraph chart type.

df2d3b9.title: Added the Changelog tab and its curated overlay
df2d3b9.description: Split /logs into Pipeline Logs and Changelog. The Changelog is a hybrid of git log and hand-curated judgment: data/changelog-overlay.json supplies the area, intensity, audit state, and module that git cannot infer, and build-changelog.mjs merges the two into the file the app reads. Added the agent definitions and the conventions guide that describe the workflow.

91f7853.title: Backfilled changelog entries for the graph editor work
91f7853.description: Added overlay entries for the graph-editor commits that predated the Changelog tab, and rebuilt the merged changelog.

4b16072.title: Group column type, grouped categories, and tab-by-column
4b16072.description: Added a semantic Group column type that imports from an exact Group header, a group role on the bar and forest chart types so categories draw in sectioned blocks, and the tab-by-column control that splits one chart into tabs over a dimension's values. Extended toPlotly, the inline shape builders, and the palette layer to carry all three.

59ea89d.title: Graph editor refinements: tab options, palettes, and export
59ea89d.description: Rounded out the previous pass: tab values now come from a module's own declared dimension values (with a saved order) rather than from whatever the last response happened to contain, plus fixes across the palette registry, inline column mapping, table export, and column-type detection.

898aa0e.title: Dataset freshness in the editor and a reworked export menu
898aa0e.description: Added GET /api/module-status, which reports the timestamp of the newest pipeline run that completed and wrote data, and a DatasetLastUpdated control that shows it in the editor. Reworked the export menu and the View Data step alongside it.

9ca30ef.description: A guide to the project's automation surfaces for a non-specialist reader, alongside notes on running local LLMs.

9a3d5ff.title: Updated the AI Comparison Guide
9a3d5ff.description: Refreshed the tool comparisons in the AI Comparison Guide.

9340fcb.description: The implementation plan for splitting the chart editor into a single-screen module workbench and a bring-your-own-data wizard. Superseded by the as-built visualization specification once the work shipped.

a7c9e1c.title: Matched the chart and data views to one height, and split the exports
a7c9e1c.description: The chart container now measures its chart view and pins the data view to the same height, so toggling between them no longer stretches the sidebar beside it. Export Chart and Export Data became separate controls: the dataset export is addressed from the config alone, so it stays available before a chart has rendered.

d7b6fcd.title: The workbench stopped filling in encodings for the reader
d7b6fcd.description: Switching chart types used to re-seed every unfilled role from the preset defaults, so clicking through the tiles showed a succession of charts nobody had asked for, and roles that could not be seeded were reported as errors. A module now opens with nothing bound and draws a skeleton naming what is still to set; no request goes out until every required encoding is the reader's own choice.

5f94fe4.title: Corrected the Automations Guide
5f94fe4.description: Fixed inaccurate steps in the Automations Guide.

2d62527.title: Revision diffing for historical module data
2d62527.description: Added a shared revision_diff layer that records what actually changed when a pipeline rewrites its historical data, and wired it into the Projections, Housing Stress, and RHNA Progress historical merges and orchestrators. Front-end surfacing followed separately.

5ed76a5.title: Transform controls for imported data
5ed76a5.description: A pasted table can now be indexed to 100 at a base period, choosing from the imported time column's own values. The section is offered only where indexing lands - a chart shape with a time axis and more than one period - and the reducer drops the transform if a later chart-type switch or re-import makes it inexpressible.

a2e0aae.title: Outcome section, Bar absorbs Diverging Bar, and per-type skeletons
a2e0aae.description: Three changes from user feedback. The Axis grid became Outcome: a chart type can now declare a role implied - a line's x is the schema's temporal field, a bar's category is its geographic level - so the duplicate Category dropdown is gone and the reader picks the measure. Diverging Bar stopped being its own chart type and became an appearance.diverging toggle on Bar, with stored views migrating automatically. The waiting skeleton now draws the shape of the chart type selected rather than bars every time. Advanced Mode returned as a single switch.

e6a1d7b.description: Added decimal-places appearance setting to format non-integer measure values across Plotly charts (hover tooltips, measure-axis ticks, value labels), and restyled the diverging bar with dashboard-style controls (threshold bucket colors, fixed value range, background track rail, minimal axis chrome) plus a new preset for one-click pace ranking styling.

80e986f.title: Multi-chart export & embed overhaul
80e986f.description: Embed the whole multi-chart workspace with a live scaled preview and one-click copy; split export into Export image and Export data buttons; added combined multi-chart image export, per-chart CSV, and multi-sheet Excel; and selectable image quality presets.

9659eff.title: Graph editor configuration, legend, and export refinements
9659eff.description: Relocated config import/export to the dataset and edit steps, implemented per-series legend visibility controls with an eye toggle in the appearance panel, and refined footnote styling with softer presentation. Improved export panel layout and capped embed dialog height.

09e6a0f.title: Symbol-map support and visualization-spec rewrite
09e6a0f.description: Extended the geography API to return representative points for each region, enabling symbol-map chart support. Rewrote the visualization specification, added chart-availability logic, and implemented feedback on outcome roles and implicit bindings.

fabf6bc.title: Removed code-generation bridge and cleaned up chart type selection
fabf6bc.description: Deleted the code-bridge layer that mapped chart configs to R and Stata code generation, along with the ChartTypeStep wizard step. Cleaned up dead code across the chart editor.

154eee8.title: Appearance panel and palette overhaul with editor capabilities framework
154eee8.description: Restructured the appearance section with new palette controls, added PPIC color ramp definitions, created an editor-capabilities framework to surface or hide features per chart type, and restored advanced mode as a single toggle. Added table transposition utilities and comprehensive test coverage.

6ed0650.title: Automations guide expanded with fourth infrastructure option; GitHub Actions reference added
6ed0650.description: Expanded the Automations Guide with a fourth infrastructure option (MoWo in a Corner: a self-hosted runner on dedicated hardware). Added comprehensive GitHub Actions workflow reference guide; updated pyproject.toml and markdown conventions.

84843ad.title: Added point-value display toggle for range and dot plots
84843ad.description: Added a show-point-values toggle to the Appearance panel for range and dot plots, letting users display or hide individual data-point values on the rendered chart.

2351a2a.title: Export menu and image library overhaul
2351a2a.description: Restructured the export menu with expanded chart export options, improved layout and styling, added image quality presets, and enhanced the exportImage library with new formatting and rendering capabilities.

5097cdd.title: Moved the project directory and refreshed docs
5097cdd.description: Relocated the project directory, updating the agent config, the convention docs, and package-lock.json to match the new path.

ec30631.title: Dev-server fix, gitignore and docs housekeeping
ec30631.description: Fixed a dev-server startup bug, extended .gitignore, and updated CLAUDE.md, pyproject.toml, and the agent docs.

0957728.title: Shared archive-and-save mechanism across all module pipelines
0957728.description: Introduced one shared archive-and-save mechanism in scripts/shared and wired all six orchestrators to it, standardizing archive file naming. Live-ran every module to verify, which surfaced the RHNA snapshot-duplication bug fixed in the following commits. 14 unit-test files updated alongside.

10d75e8.title: Fixed RHNA snapshot duplication that double-counted every jurisdiction
10d75e8.description: A same-day pipeline re-run duplicated every row, so the frontend rendered each jurisdiction twice: combine_snapshots de-duplicated on the raw Snapshot Date column, and both copies carried the Most Recent flag the default query filters on. Fixed the de-duplication key and withheld the module from the landing page until the data was trustworthy.

be0f1e9.title: RHNA accumulated date columns now parse tolerantly everywhere
be0f1e9.description: Follow-up to the snapshot-duplication fix, which corrected the mixed-representation date parse in only two of the six places that needed it. The live re-run then failed Phase 5 with a Status inconsistent with the four-quadrant rule - not a Status bug, but an unparsed date column. Every accumulated date column now parses tolerantly.

88ea330.title: Restored RHNA Progress Report to the landing page
88ea330.description: Returned the module to the landing page once the snapshot-duplication and date-parsing fixes were verified, and updated its module specification.

61451e6.title: Archive-and-save follow-up tweaks and CI workflow update
61451e6.description: Refinements to the shared archive-and-save mechanism with its unit tests, plus an update to the GitHub Actions workflow.

6439ee0.title: Project specification refresh
6439ee0.description: Brought projectSpec.md up to date with the preceding pipeline and front-end work.

8701317.title: Chart editor: appearance, chart-type, labels and wizard refinements
8701317.description: Reworked the Appearance, Chart Type, Labels, and Editor Sidebar sections plus the wizard's Edit step, with matching toPlotly changes and a visualization-specification update.

9163f9d.title: Log records and sample feed refresh
9163f9d.description: Updated the shared logging helper and its unit test, and refreshed the committed sample-runs.jsonl fixture that keeps the /logs page populated in the repo.

77f0e83.title: Added a Home link to the navbar
77f0e83.description: The navbar now carries an explicit Home link to the landing page alongside the PPIC logo, with a test pinning both targets.

870fd19.title: Legend titles are now editable
870fd19.description: Added legend-title renaming through the Appearance section and the palette picker, carried on the chart spec and applied in toPlotly so the label survives save, export, and reload.

b4a5e6e.title: Forest plot refinements
b4a5e6e.description: Updated the forest chart's registry and preset descriptors, its appearance controls, and its toPlotly builder.

cd53165.title: Editor tweaks from the August 11 project meeting
cd53165.description: A broad pass over the chart editor from meeting feedback: Appearance, Geography, Labels, Outcome, Transform, and category controls, plus the palette picker, multi-chart toolbar, advanced-mode gate, config store, and navbar. Specification updated to match.

23bd0b9.title: Follow-up editor and workbench tweaks
23bd0b9.description: Continued the meeting-feedback pass across the config store, chart data loading, the resizable sidebar, the module workbench and its sidebar, and the wizard shell, with chart-spec changes and specification updates.

8df37f5.title: Landing page rebuilt as a topic directory; ESLint cleanup
8df37f5.description: Replaced the landing page's category dashboards with a directory of six topic cards, one per built module, each linking into that module's chart editor. Routes and labels derive from a single topic registry that the navbar also reads, so they cannot drift; the retired dashboard components moved to .trash/ and categoryRegistry.js became builtInViews.js, keeping every ?view= deep-link working. Separately, react/prop-types was turned off once in eslint.config.js instead of via a per-file pragma in 107 files, and the React version is now detected rather than assumed.

930baa5.title: Ignored the Python virtual environment
930baa5.description: Added web-viz-venv/ to .gitignore so the local Python virtual environment stops appearing as untracked work.

ccb27e6.title: Changelog entries for the preceding export and editor work
ccb27e6.description: Added six curated overlay entries covering the export-options cleanup and the commits before it, and regenerated data/changelog.json.

3d54d56.title: Multi-chart returned to the module workbench; dropdown handling fixed
3d54d56.description: Restored the multi-chart workspace on the module editor by threading it through the editor-capabilities context, so the workbench and the standalone wizard share one definition of what multiChart means. Also fixed dropdown handling in the settings sections' shared primitives, and updated the UI Kit patterns showcase.
